tagline: Leading provider of integrated subsea and marine services to the global offshore energy market
hero_kpi_rationale: The firm backlog is the primary visibility indicator for future revenues in offshore services, reflecting structural demand and the health of the energy investment cycle.

kpis.name: Firm Backlog
kpis.explanation: Total value of signed contracts not yet completed.
kpis.description: The firm backlog reached $2.75B at end of September 2024, compared to $2.1B one year earlier. Additional contracts of approximately $90M were signed after close.
kpis.signal: Backlog at $2.75B, up sharply, with +$90M in new post-close contracts.

kpis.name: EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Operating profit before depreciation and amortization.
kpis.description: EBITDA reached $141M in Q3 2024 versus $123M one year prior. EBITDA margin declined slightly to 37% vs. 38%.
kpis.signal: EBITDA growing to $141M, despite slight margin compression.

kpis.name: Operating Revenue
kpis.description: Operating revenue reached $376M in Q3 2024, up from $322M in Q3 2023.

kpis.name: EBITDA Margin
kpis.description: EBITDA margin was 37% in Q3 2024 versus 38% one year prior.
kpis.signal: Margin stable despite growth, slightly compressed.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Bottom line result after charges and taxes.
kpis.description: Net income reached $69M versus $27M one year prior, driven by an unrealized FX gain of $17M related to BRL.
kpis.signal: Net income tripled thanks to unrealized FX gain.

kpis.name: Fleet Utilization Rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of time vessels are in service.
kpis.description: Average fleet utilization rate was 92% in Q3 2024 versus 85% one year prior, indicating strong demand.
kpis.signal: High utilization rate at 92%, up significantly.

kpis.name: Net Debt
kpis.explanation: Financial debt after deduction of cash and equivalents.
kpis.description: Net debt decreased from $1,372M to $1,143M thanks to cash flow generation and a capital increase.

kpis.name: Net Debt to EBITDA Ratio
kpis.explanation: Indicator of solvency and financial leverage.
kpis.description: The NIBD / EBITDA ratio on a 12-month basis was 2.3x at end of September 2024 versus 3.0x one year prior.
kpis.signal: Improved debt coverage, declining from 3.0x to 2.3x.
